data.title: Call logging in LANARS Sales Engine
data.intro: After a call on your work line, this app sends the call to the Sales Engine, LANARS's CRM, so it shows on the right deal. Read this before the app sends anything.

sections.heading: What is sent
items: When a call on the work line ends, its number is checked against the CRM. This happens before you can tap Private, and the check stores nothing.
An invented second item, standing in for the ones the document cuts.
